peak_ram_gib.notes: Measure on the declared hardware profile while executing the scoring suite.

p50_first_token_ms.notes: Measure from inference process start to first generated stdout byte with prompt display disabled. Current process-per-request llama.cpp backend therefore includes process/model startup cost.

notes: All correctness cases are synthetic OYYO-authored fixtures, not copied public benchmark items.
These compact engineering fixtures are for candidate selection hygiene, not public claims of general intelligence.
Broader external benchmarks may be added later only with explicit contamination/provenance review.
